queue.emptyBody: New discrepancies and deadlines appear here.
queue.unknown: {{names}} did not respond, so we do not know what is waiting. It appears here once the data loads.

tools.noRole: You have no role in this tool

start.sub: Welcome. Let's set up your company first, then the tools you will use.
start.subTools: Setup progress for the tools you use appears here.
start.companyHint: Name, country, currency, time zone. Tools use these details from here.
start.teamHint: Give roles to your staff and your accountant.
start.toolsNote: Each tool is set up inside the tool

simple.mobileTitle: This role works in the mobile app
simple.mobileBody: Your {{tool}} role is {{role}}. You take measurements in the SellerOnData Android app.
simple.step1: Your admin will share the Android app. Install it on your phone.
simple.step3: Scan the parcel, measure it, save.
simple.noRoleTitle: You have no role in this company
simple.noRoleBody: You can continue once your company admin gives you a role in a tool.
simple.appSlot: The app is not in the stores yet and there is no iOS version. Ask your admin for the install file.

tool.noAccessBody: Ask your company admin for a role to use this tool.
tool.notOpenTitle: {{name}} is not enabled for your company

soon.body: This tool is not open yet. When it opens it will work here, with the same account.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may have changed or been mistyped.

analytics.setupBody: The remaining steps are in the Getting started list. Numbers appear here after the first invoice.

data.noneBody: This tool does not offer any datasets yet.
data.noMatchBody: Change the search or the filters.
data.emptyBody: Records appear here as data is added in the tool.
data.exportTooLarge: Could not download the CSV: too many rows
data.sortNeedsCurrency: Choose a currency to sort by amount: different currencies cannot be ranked against each other.
data.exportEmpty: There are no records to export.

activity.sourceError: Could not load {{name}} activity. The rest is below.
activity.emptyBody: Work done in the tools appears here.

actions.person.phone_linked: linked a phone to their account
actions.person.password_reset_by_code: reset their password with a code

activity.filterLoadedOnly: Filters apply to loaded records. Load more below for older ones.

team.title: Team and permissions
team.sub: {{people}} active, {{invites}} pending. Change a role in its row; it applies right away.
team.subLoading: Change a role in its row; it applies right away.
team.lockSelf: You cannot change your own membership.
team.lockOwner: Only the owner can change the owner.
team.lockOwnerAction: Does not apply to the owner.
team.lockAdmin: Only the company owner can change an admin's role.
team.removeBody: They lose access to this company and its tools. The account is not deleted and their records stay.
team.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
team.revokeConfirmBody: The link sent to {{email}} will stop working.
team.inviteBody: Invite someone once and give them a separate role in each tool.
team.kindPhoneHelp: For employees without email. The system creates a code; you pass it on in person or by WhatsApp.
team.kindEmailHelp: Creates an invitation link. You can copy and send it yourself if the email does not arrive.
team.name: Full name
team.orgRoleHelp: Admins manage the team and the company. Employees only see their tools.
team.orgRoleHelpAdmin: Only the company owner can make someone an admin.
team.linkBody: {{name}} joins with this link. It works for 7 days.
team.messageCopied: Message copied. You can paste it into WhatsApp
team.codeOnce: This code is not shown again. It works for 72 hours and is revoked after 5 wrong attempts.
team.codeHow: They go to {{url}}, enter their phone number and the code, and set their own password.
team.codeMessage: {{org}} invited you to SellerOnData. Go to {{url}} and enter your phone number and this code: {{code}}. The code works for 72 hours. Your admin will share the Android app for measuring.
team.resetMessage: To renew your SellerOnData password, go to {{url}} and enter your phone number and this code: {{code}}. The code works for 72 hours.

resetReason.SELF_RESET: A code can't be created for this person here; they need to reset their password themselves.
resetReason.NOT_ACTIVE: A code cannot be created for a suspended person. Resume them first.

team.exhaustedTitle: This code has no attempts left
team.exhaustedBody: A new code cannot be created for {{name}}. Revoke the invitation and invite again. The details are filled in for you.
team.mailNotSent: The email could not be sent right now. Copy the link and send it yourself.
team.inviteLimit: This company has used its invitations for now. New companies have a lower hourly limit. Try again soon; what you typed is kept.
team.inviteLimitIn: This company has used its invitations for now. New companies have a lower hourly limit. Try again in about {{minutes}} minutes; what you typed is kept.

orgRoleDesc.OWNER: One person. Manages the company, the subscription and ownership.
orgRoleDesc.ADMIN: Manages the team and company settings. Cannot change the owner or other admins.
orgRoleDesc.MEMBER: Can only do what their role in the tool allows.

team.noMatchBody: Change the search or the filters.
team.confirmAdminBody: {{name}} can manage the team and company settings, invite people and change roles. Effective immediately.
team.confirmSelfBody: Some of your permissions are removed immediately and the {{tool}} menu changes.
team.confirmNoAccessBody: {{name}} can no longer enter {{tool}}, and any open session is affected immediately. Their records are not deleted.
team.confirmSuspendBody: {{name}} cannot sign in again. In an already open tab, data can stay visible until they return to the tab or change page; new records and changes are rejected right away. Their records are not deleted and you can resume later.
team.confirmSelfNoAccessBody: Your access to the tool closes completely. Another admin may be needed to open it again.
team.appShareBody: People who measure use the Android app. It is not in the stores: you send them the install file (APK). There is no iOS version.
team.appShareNoLink: The download link is not set yet. Whoever runs the installation adds it.
team.codeAppNote: If they will measure, share the Android app too. It is not in the stores.
team.mailOff: Email sending is off on this installation. Copy the link and send it yourself.
team.mailLocalOnly: The email was not sent: this installation has no mail server, so it was only written to the local test mailbox. Copy the link and send it yourself.
team.linkHintManual: The link is not shown again once this window closes.
team.linkHintSent: The invitation email was sent. You can also share the link yourself. The link is not shown again once this window closes.
team.confirmSelfUpBody: Your permissions widen immediately and new sections appear in the {{tool}} menu.

company.title: Company
company.sub: The company name appears in every tool and on invoices.
company.name: Company name
company.nameClipped: At most {{max}} characters; anything longer is left out. Please check the name.
company.currencyHelp: New records default to this, in DeciShip too. Existing records keep their amount and currency; nothing is converted.
company.localeHelp: Invitation emails are sent in this language. Notifications reach each person in the language they chose.
company.timeZoneHelp: Daily counts, deadlines and exports use this time zone.
company.ownerOnly: Only the company owner can transfer ownership.
company.transferNone: There is no active person to transfer to.
company.transferPasswordHelp: Confirm this action with your password.
company.transferEmailRule: Ownership can only go to someone who has verified their email address.
company.ownerRequiresEmail: This person has no email address. Ownership can only go to someone with an email. Ask them to add one first.
company.ownerRequiresVerified: This person has not verified their email address yet. Ownership can only go to a verified address. Ask them to open the verification email.
company.confirmBody: Check the details and confirm them. Tools use the currency and time zone from here; you can still change them later.
company.confirmReturn: After you confirm, you go back to where you were.

billing.sub: Your company's tools and current plan. No payments are taken at the moment.

status.READ_ONLY: Read only: records are visible, but changes are disabled.

billing.payNote: You will manage these here once payments open. You do not need to do anything for now.

createOrg.title: New company
createOrg.sub: Adds another company to your account. You become its owner and it becomes active.
createOrg.note: Tools are in early access. No payment is taken.
createOrg.emptySub: Your account is open but you are not in a company. Open yours to continue, or ask your admin for an invitation.
createOrg.closedTitle: A new company cannot be opened
createOrg.closedBody: New registrations are closed at the moment. Ask a company admin for an invitation to join.
createOrg.needsEmail: Add an email to your account before opening a company. Nobody else can recover the password of a company owner.
createOrg.suspendedTitle: Your membership in this company is suspended
createOrg.suspendedBody: Contact your admin. You continue where you left off once it is resumed.

leave.body: You lose access to {{org}} and its tools. Your account is not deleted and your records stay with the company.
leave.confirmBody: You will need a new invitation from an admin to come back.
leave.recoveryWarn: Your account has no email address. If you leave and forget your password, there is no way to recover it. Add an email above first.
leave.passwordHelp: Accounts without email confirm this with the password.

aiSpend.title: AI spend
aiSpend.billingNote: AI spend of all your tools in one place: by tool, purpose, model, day and person.
aiSpend.exportTooLarge: There are too many calls in this range. Narrow the range and try again.
aiSpend.emptyTitle: No AI was used in this period.
aiSpend.emptyBody: Spend appears here as your tools use AI.

band.paused: AI is paused across the platform right now. AI features in your tools are off until it is turned back on.
band.capped: This month's AI allowance is used up. AI features turn back on on {{date}}.
band.warn: {{pct}}% of this month's AI allowance is used.

status.paused: AI is paused for all companies. New calls are rejected.
status.unavailable: AI is unavailable right now: there is no working provider key.
status.stale: The price table is out of date: {{providers}}. Amounts may not be exact.

keys.title: Provider keys
keys.sub: A key is never shown on screen; only its last four characters.
keys.inputHelp: It is tested with the provider for free before it is saved.
keys.testFailed: The provider did not accept the key.
keys.removeBody: AI features that use this provider stop once it is removed.

limits.title: Platform limits
limits.sub: Total spend of all companies. New calls are rejected once a limit is reached.
limits.pauseBody: Calls in progress finish, new ones are rejected. Turning it back on asks for your password.

orgs.title: Companies (this month)
orgs.none: No company has used AI this month.
orgs.capHelp: Leave it empty to go back to the default allowance.

stepUp.title: Enter your password again
stepUp.body: This change needs your password. You will not be asked again for 5 minutes.
